derivation.rule_1_note: ONE law, no sweeps. The fore pose has exactly two continuous unknowns (shoulder q1, elbow q2 -- shared by both legs through the mirror) and both are PINNED by requires that already exist: (1) the compile-time seating scan (all 8 contact gaps in (0, 1e-5) at the standing pose) pins the pad FLAT (heel and MP gaps equal to within the band's pitch tolerance ~1.2e-4 rad) and pins the paw HEIGHT (gap = the authored +2e-6 seating target, the same gap the hind contacts are authored at) -- two equations, two unknowns, discrete branch. The capture-offset equation is then not free: it is PREDICTED from the pinned pose plus baseline-measured settle kinematics, and the pose_installed falsifier judges it. If the prediction misses, that is a finding about the settle transfer, never a re-solve.
derivation.the_pose_law: STANDING-PIN: solve Assembly(model) at the standing defaults (hind q=0, base at leg_drop+2e-6, base_rot 0) for (q1, q2) such that fore heel gap = fore MP gap = reset_gap_target (2e-6). Two roots exist (elbow-behind branch, elbow-forward branch); the branch is a DISCRETE choice, not a sweep: evaluate the capture equation on both, keep the one that satisfies it, report both. CAPTURE-EQUATION: offset_capture(q1) = [paw_ref_x - shoulder_x at the RUNTIME leaned reset pose, Assembly-exact] + delta_settle, where delta_settle is the MEASURED settle transfer of the baseline wave-13 binary (measured capture offset0 minus the SAME Assembly prediction for the OLD pose, per leg) -- the pelvis advance (friction-pinned paws, translating shoulders) plus trunk-pitch drift, assumed pose-invariant to first order; the assumption is named and tested by pose_installed. TARGET: offset_capture = +x_off, x_off = v_settle_end*(DUTY_SAMPLED*T_CYCLE)/2, v_settle_end MEASURED from the baseline trace at tick 60 (the wave-13 receipt's [foreclk] xoff=0.101938 at v[3]@60=0.4204 is the prior; re-measured on this lane's own baseline run).
derivation.the_entry_clock_law: With the capture at the touchdown offset, the entry stance of each fore leg is timed by the LATERAL-SEQUENCE LIFT GRID: lift(leg) = now + (DUTY_SAMPLED - phi_hind_same_side)*T_CYCLE/dt ticks + T_CYCLE/(4*dt) ticks -- the fore lift = same-side hind lift + T/4 evaluated ONCE at the arm (hind phases at arm are the entry values {0, 0.5}); entry stance = min(lift_wait, tau_env), tau_env = the annulus hold bound with the offset's actual direction: off0 >= 0: (off0 + a - v*dt)/(v*T_CYCLE) periods (the shoulder walks ONTO the plant before receding); off0 < 0: the wave-13 form (a - |off0| - v*dt)/(v*T_CYCLE). The wave-13 duty cap on the entry stance is DISSOLVED: the grid-derived LF stance (0.933*T) lawfully exceeds the steady stance because the capture is at +x_off, not behind; the envelope remains the guard. STAGGER DERIVED: with hind phases {0, 0.5} at arm, RF lift = 60 + (0.683-0.5)*213 + 53.25 ~ 152.2, LF lift = 60 + 0.683*213 + 53.25 ~ 258.7 -- 106.5 ticks = T/2 apart, and both land ON the steady lift slots (RF 152.25 = 0.433*213+60, LF 258.75 = 0.933*213+60 of the wave-13 lateral grid), so the first TDs (219.7 / 326.2) are ON the steady TD slots and the grid convergence terminates at |d| <= 0.5 -- converged at first TD with zero correction. Swings are 67.5 ticks < T/2 apart: disjoint by construction, at every cycle.
derivation.envelope_closure: The stance sweep traverses offset from +x_off down to the lift offset x_off - v*t_entry: LF t_entry = 198.7 ticks -> lift offset 0.101938 - 0.4204*0.6624 = -0.1766 m, |.| + v*dt <= a: 0.1766+0.0014 = 0.178 <= 0.245054 (measured a at the capture height) -- margin 0.067 m. RF t_entry = 92.2 ticks -> lift offset -0.0273 -- margin 0.216 m. FULL-SWEEP inequality (the prompt's form): total sweep 2*x_off + swing chase r_sw <= 2a: 2*0.101938 + 0.08 <= 0.513762 -- closes with 0.23 m slack at the measured v. Numbers re-measured on this lane's baseline; the script re-checks with its own measured inputs.
